title: CIA declassified Arc Light mission records, 18 June – 15 November 1965
citation: Appendix I, 'ARC LIGHT MISSIONS: 18 June 1965 – 15 November 1965' (CIA-RDP78S02149R000100060004-0) and Appendix IV, 'Analysis of ARC LIGHT Program by Target Zone' with Figure 1 strike map, 17 June – 15 November 1965 (CIA-RDP78S02149R000100060013-0). Approved for release 31 August 2001, CIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.
notes: The complete B-52 strike record for the war's first five months: 1,153 sorties (June 30, July 151, August 177, September 327, October 297, 1–15 November 171). The strike maps show no Arc Light mission near Núi Bà Đen in late July–early September 1965; the strikes near Tây Ninh (CAT PAW I–VI, FINE SAND) came 28 October–14 November 1965, after Larry's departure. Used to rule out a B-52 strike as the mechanism of the '450 civilians' day.
